data.title: KACCC Signs MoU with National Committee of Workers Committees to Promote Workplace Dialogue
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The King Abdulaziz Center for Cultural Communication (KACCC) signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Saudi National Committee of Workers Committees in Riyadh on Sunday. The MoU aims to promote dialogue and positive communication in the workplace, strengthen professional relations, and build capacities. It also seeks to foster understanding and mutual respect between employees and employers.
    The agreement draws on KACCC's expertise in dialogue and cultural communication and the committee's role in facilitating dialogue among parties to labor relations. This cooperation aims to improve the work environment, enhance job stability, and promote mutual understanding.
    Areas of cooperation include exchanging studies, research, and expertise; conducting public opinion surveys; and organizing training programs, workshops, seminars, and joint forums. The two sides will also prepare reports and indicators to measure societal trends and support decision-making. The MoU covers joint initiatives and programs, including sports activities, as well as the exchange of knowledge and best practices. Both sides will make use of their facilities and resources to organize activities and events of mutual interest.
    The partnership is part of KACCC's efforts to expand its institutional partnerships and support work environments based on respect, understanding, and cooperation, in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
    -- SPA
